name: Ra
subtitle: Divine Eclipse
description: Bring the power of the sun to burn your foes increasing your own power in battle.
lore: He is the sun, master of the heavens. For all his might, however, Ra’s immense age and responsibilities have begun to catch up with him. Although one would never guess it, witnessing his efforts on Aaru’s behalf in the War of Pyramids, Ra grows tired—and that exhaustion has rendered him angry, even tyrannical in his need to solve the realm’s problems now.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when enemies are damaged by [Blaze].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Fires of Creation
Ignore DEF +10%, Ignore RES +20%, DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Eye of Ra

skills.name: Sun Crescent Sweep
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (300%ATK+200%ACC) with a 75% chance to increase the duration of [mechanic:blaze] by 1 turn. If the attack is critical, activate [mechanic:blaze] on the target.

skills.name: Eye of Ra
skills.description: When [mechanic:blaze] on allies or enemies activates, expires, or is removed, increase the damage of the next Ultimate by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also has a 50% chance to activate [Blaze] on any attack

skills.name: Fires of Creation
skills.description: Attack all enemies (360%ATK+230%ACC) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:blaze-ii] for 3 turns. If this ability defeats an enemy, decrease its cooldown by 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Then increase C.DMG by 3% for each [Blaze II] placed (stacking up to 15 times)

skills.name: Solar Convergence
skills.description: Attack all enemies (125%ATK+75%ACC)3 times. Each hit has a 35% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-ii] and [mechanic:vulnerable-ii] on each target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an enemy is defeated, increase the duration of [Blaze] on all enemies by 1 turn.

imprint_passive: When any [Blaze] on allies or enemies activates, expires, or is removed, increase the damage of the next Ultimate by 2.5%.
